# `assets/geometry/PrincipalAxes.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/geometry/PrincipalAxes.js`

engine/assets/geometry/PrincipalAxes.js — Principal Component Analysis of an EngineModel node's geometry. Small, dependency-free, GPU-free, and reusable: any engine system can ask for the natural axes of a mesh (oriented bounds, alignment, the axle of a wheel disc, the long axis of a barrel, etc.).  PCA finds the orthogonal axes of greatest → least variance of the vertex cloud. A disc/cylinder is thin along its axle, so its axle is the axis of LEAST variance — orientation- and mirror-proof, unlike axis-aligned guesses.

## Functions

### `eigSym3(m)`

Jacobi eigen-decomposition of a symmetric 3×3 (row-major length-9 array).

### `principalAxes(model, nodeId, opts = {})`

PCA of a node's mesh-local vertex cloud.

**Returns:** |null}

### `leastVarianceAxis(model, nodeId, opts = {})`

Convenience: the axis of LEAST variance (e.g. a wheel/disc axle), or null.
